name: Shyama Backup
author: Priyanka Behera

sections.description:
Shyama Backup is a simple and reliable WordPress backup plugin that allows administrators to create downloadable backups of website components with a single click.

Features:

  • Database backup
  • Uploads backup
  • Plugins backup
  • Themes backup
  • ZIP archive generation
  • Backup history
  • Download backups
  • Delete backups
  • AJAX-powered backup creation
  • Modern admin interface

Shyama Backup helps website owners generate complete backups without complicated configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shyama-backup directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Shyama Backup in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select the components to back up.
  5. Click “Create Backup”.
sections.faq:
Where are backups stored?

Backups are stored in the Shyama Backup backup directory.

What can be included in a backup?

You can choose:

  • Database
  • Uploads
  • Plugins
  • Themes

Does Shyama Backup support restore functionality?

Restore functionality is planned for a future release.
